doc: Sets CD command-buffer byte D_800814D4=0x84 (mode flags), then retries CdControlB(CdlSetmode=0xE, &buf, NULL) up to 16 times until it returns nonzero (success); if all 16 attempts fail, calls func_8003E70C() (CD re-init) before finally calling func_8003F5EC() (busy-wait ~0x200 VSyncs) unconditionally.

globals.name: D_800814D4
globals.decl: extern u8 D_800814D4; // single command-mode byte, gp_rel scalar store

globals.name: D_800814D3
globals.decl: extern u8 D_800814D3[8]; // neighbour >8B array whose [1] element aliases D_800814D4; used only to force hi/lo address-of codegen for &D_800814D4 passed as CdControlB's param pointer

calls: func_8003E70C(void) -- no arguments (its own body never reads a0)
CdControlB(u8 com, u8 *param, u8 *result) -- PSY-Q libcd function, addr 0x80061064
